name: Yucca Valley Youth Commission
what_you_do: Plan teen events, help at Town programs and share ideas for youth services. You report to a Town commission. You also give a year-end report to the Town Council.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 7 to 12. The Town picks a small group each year and tries to include a mix of schools and grades.
pay_detail: The program page does not list pay.
duration: School year. One meeting a month, plus some workshops. Not active in summer.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 were due Sept. 2, per a Town news release dated Aug 12, 2026. Dates for 2027-28 are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Town page when the next round opens. As of Nov 2, 2026, the page has no open form. You can call or email now to ask.
notes: Past members can be picked again. To ask a question, call 760-369-7212 or email childerbrand@yucca-valley.org.
